subjects.name: SvMinePumpStep
subjects.domain: water enum 0/1/2=low/normal/high, all state flags; explicit arbitrary prior state
subjects.adaptation: Inline feature-wrapper calls and enum switches; preserve water lowering before environment processing and the counterintuitive original !isLowWaterSensorDry test (water!=low); encode pump*10+water. No reachability claim.

subjects.name: SvTcasClimb
subjects.domain: four altitude layers; up/down = ALIM(layer)+100*delta, delta -2..2; vertical separation 500/600/700; own/other altitude 1/0 if above else 0/0; inhibit bool
subjects.adaptation: Extract non-crossing climb predicate (not full advisory); inline helpers and expose fields. Preserve original comparison order and return boolean encoded 0/1.

subjects.name: SvBellmanFord3
subjects.domain: N=3, source=0; edges 1->0 and 2->0 fixed to 4; other four weights 0..4; diagonal ignored
subjects.adaptation: Scalarize distances; unfold fixed 3x3 edge scans in original order; retain pass loop and early exit. All nodes become finite in first row so infinite guards are provably true at subsequent edges. Encode distances to nodes1/2 as 10*d1+d2; d0 remains0. No negative cycles.

subjects.name: SvTokenIdentifier
subjects.domain: exactly three printable ASCII characters followed by NUL
subjects.adaptation: Flatten token array and inline character classification; preserve scan and early rejection. Does not tokenize streams or recognize other token classes.

subjects.name: SvReplaceAtom
subjects.domain: kind 0 literal,1 any,2 two-member class,3 negated class; codes 0..10, index0/1
subjects.adaptation: Scalarize one pattern atom and class contents; inline locate reverse scan; return updated index on match, -1 on failure. Exclude anchors/closure and complete replace pipeline.

subjects.name: SvCliOption
subjects.adaptation: Inline option validation helper chain; exception -> -1 and success ->1. Preserve dot/underscore acceptance present in implementation despite narrower prose comments. Small reserve subject; not full CLI parsing.

subjects.name: D4jLevenshtein23
subjects.domain: strings length2 and3 over codes1..3; non-null
subjects.adaptation: Scalarize two working distance arrays, inline Math.min and ternary; retain nested dynamic-programming loops and recurrence. Fixed nonempty dimensions remove null/empty/swap branches. Return edit distance.

subjects.name: D4jCharSqueeze
subjects.domain: four digits1..3 mapped to Java characters 1..3; charset inclusive range low..high within1..3
subjects.adaptation: Flatten text and replace charset range lookup with integer comparison; retain suppression loop and last-character state; encode complete output as nonzero decimal digits (injective).

subjects.name: D4jArrayLastIndex
subjects.domain: three-element non-null int array, values/key0..4; startIndex -1..4
subjects.adaptation: Flatten array, preserve backward scan and start-index clamping. Distinct from prior delimiter earliest-match scan.

subjects.name: D4jMonotonicOrder
subjects.domain: three exact integer-valued doubles -3..3; both directions/strictness; abort=false
subjects.adaptation: Flatten array and enum, specialize abort=false, replace labeled early-break with equivalent return. Integer mapping exact on finite domain; no claim for NaN, infinities or rounding.
